FIXED 2026-09-21 02:4xZ ops-triage -- the misconfigured target AND the detector that watched it. (1) CONFIG: the three jobs carried deliver=origin with origin platform 'webui', which the gateway cannot resolve (Platform has no webui member), so every run logged last_status=delivery_failed 'unknown platform webui' while the output still landed in cron/output/<id>/. Set all three to deliver=local with 'hermes cron edit <id> --deliver local' (43b0d5c4446d, 8d3ac21799d5, 9c05f60f5fef; verified in jobs.json: deliver='local' on all four turbo-carnival jobs, matching the already-ok tc-overnight-watchdog). Chosen over slack/email on purpose: the profile DOES have real home channels (measured with the delivery resolver + the profile .env: slack C0B3N4DAY7Q, email tim@lawrenz.com both resolve), but pushing hourly reports to a human channel is a decision, not a silent config change -- recorded under needs-a-human. (2) DETECTOR: cron_delivery_verdict keyed on last_status, which is HISTORICAL -- with the target fixed the board would have carried this item until each job next ran (7 days for the weekly one). It now fires only when a job still ASKS for delivery (configured target != local) and its last attempt failed; new pure helper _asks_for_delivery + 3 selftest cases (target-fixed-historical-status, target-fixed-in-list, still-asking-still-broken). VERIFIED: selftest 171 assertions / 0 failures; probe 0 critical / 0 warn / 3 info; NEEDS_HUMAN regenerated. 'hermes cron doctor' still lists the 3 jobs because it reads the historical status field -- expected, and it clears on each job's next run.
